evals.prompt: Create a skill named releasing-packages that walks an agent through tagging and publishing an npm package: bump the version, run the test suite, tag the commit, publish with npm, and verify the published version.
evals.expected_output: A skill directory releasing-packages/ with a SKILL.md and an evals/evals.json that passes scripts/measure.sh.
expectations: The directory is named releasing-packages and the frontmatter name matches it
The description is written in the third person and states what the skill does and when to use it
The frontmatter declares compatibility with git and npm
The workflow opens with a progress checklist the agent copies into its response
Every step ends on a checkable completion criterion
The publish step has low freedom: an exact command, not a choice of approaches
At least three evaluations exist in evals/evals.json before the body is considered done
scripts/measure.sh on the new directory reports no FAIL
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent writes an imperative description, skips compatibility and evaluations, and gives each step a vague bound such as 'make sure tests pass'.

evals.prompt: Review the skill in skills/engineering/implement-work-item against the writing-for-agents skill. Report findings only; change nothing.
evals.expected_output: A review in the report format of SKILL-REVIEW.md, ordered blocking, behavioural, pruning, with a file and line per finding and no files changed.
expectations: The report begins with the measured body lines, description length, and validator result from scripts/measure.sh
The imperative description ('Implement one tracker work item ...') is reported as a third-person violation with a proposed rewrite
The missing compatibility declaration for gh and az is reported
The absence of output templates for the reports in steps 8, 10, and 11 is reported
The absence of evals/evals.json is reported
The host-specific invocation syntax in the description is reported as a portability finding
No file in the repository is modified
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent lists stylistic impressions without line references, misses the third-person rule and the compatibility field, and often edits the file while reviewing.

evals.prompt: Add a line to AGENTS.md so that the agent reads docs/agents/issue-tracker.md before creating, reading, or closing tickets. Edit only AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md gains one line that acts as a context pointer to docs/agents/issue-tracker.md.
expectations: Exactly one line is added to AGENTS.md and no other file changes
The line leads with the trigger (creating, reading, or closing tickets) before naming the file
The line names docs/agents/issue-tracker.md as a path
The line restates nothing from issue-tracker.md itself; the tracker's state names and type roles stay in that file
The existing line about docs/agents/domain.md is left unchanged
evals.baseline: Without the skill the agent adds a paragraph that summarises the tracker document into AGENTS.md, duplicating its content and burying the pointer.
